maria: Quick dump from today's perf run — noticed a hit-rate collapse on KV prefix cache for chat+RAG workload after the kernel swap.

maria: TL;DR: when kernel switches to fp16-quant path we see ~60% drop in KV hit-rate for certain session shapes (short-heavy).

aj: Can you paste the trace/metric lines?

maria: ```
profile: run=canary-2026-03-17
workload: chat+r/doc-retrieval
kernel: fused-attn-v2 -> fast-quant
seq_dist: {short: 65%, mid: 30%, long:5%}
kvcache.hitrate.global=0.78 -> 0.31
latency.p50=34ms -> 52ms
spill.evictions=+2200
```

sahil: Interesting — kernel picks changed because average seq_len dropped; batching heuristic coalesced many small sessions causing different key prefix boundaries? Could be key fingerprint collisions on our normalization layer.

maria: I think it's the canonicalization + shingling interaction. We recently added a `normalize_whitespace` step in canonicalizer which changed prefix fingerprints for bot-prompt tokens.

jen: If canonicalizer changes, old cache entries won't match -> cold misses. Did we try running with old canonicalizer on same kernel?

maria: Yes: when forcing canonicalizer=v1 we get hitrate back to 0.74. With v2 it's 0.33. So it's the keying, but it only shows up with the new kernel because tokenization offsets shift warm prefix boundaries.

aj: Two actions: 1) revert normalize_whitespace in canonicalizer for canary, 2) add a short-term prefetch: when session starts, precompute N next kv-keys using tokenizer offsets and prime cache. Can we simulate priming cost?

maria: Simulated priming (N=3) added ~2.1ms overhead but recovered 0.5 p90; hitrate recovered to 0.68 for chat flows.

perf-bot: perf-run 2176543210 complete — baseline vs canary diff attached (s3://redwood/perf/2176543210)

sahil: Also let's add logging for key fingerprint sizes and a sampler that prints fingerprint diffs for same prompt across kernels. We should capture when shingle windows move because of token offsets.

jen: I'll wire a canary that 1) pins canonicalizer=v1, 2) enables priming=3, 3) enables fingerprint-telemetry (1% sampling). Rollout to 5% in us-west.

deploy-bot: @jen deployed canary can01 to us-west 5% at 2026-03-17T15:12:08Z :rocket:

aj: If canary looks good, plan for a rollback of v2 canonicalizer from main and follow-up design meeting on keying semantics. Also put this in eng-runtime retro.

maria: thanks — i'll attach a short reproducer and the script to diff tokens between kernels.

maria: reproducer gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/abcdef123456

aj: ack :thumbsup:
